comment_box:
Veterans of America respectfully opposes the proposed rollback of reproductive healthcare access within VA facilities.
As veterans, caregivers, and advocates, we see firsthand how essential it is for veterans to receive care when facing the most serious reproductive health challenges.
The February 2024 Regulatory Impact Analysis clearly outlined the life-saving and medically necessary nature of this care, especially for veterans impacted by trauma, assault, or serious pregnancy complications.
Removing this access not only endangers lives — it contradicts VA’s mission to provide "needed" care and undermines parity with other federal health systems.
We urge the VA to uphold its duty of care and protect the vulnerable veterans who depend on it most
